name: Redundant Global Constraint and Matrix Trace Disguise
description: Replaces the algebraic equation with a matrix trace property that still evaluates to XOR, and introduces a formidable-sounding global cycle constraint. The cycle constraint requires equal numbers of 1s and 2s in any cycle, which is a tautological property of any valid 2-coloring. This forces models to abandon simple BFS and attempt exponential-time cycle finding or CSP solvers, leading to structural failure or Timeout.
